verses.text: I will stand at my post and take my place on the city wall. I will watch to see what the LORD will say to me and how I should answer my complaint.
Then the LORD answered me: "Write down the vision. Make it clear on tablets, so that anyone who reads it can run and tell others.
The vision is waiting for its appointed time. It is hurrying toward the end, and it will not prove false. Even if it seems slow, wait for it. It will surely come. It will not be late.
"Look at the proud one. He is not honest in what he wants. But the righteous person will live by his faithfulness.

Wine also betrays the proud man, and he is never at rest. His greed is as wide as the grave, and like death he is never satisfied. He gathers all the nations for himself and collects all the peoples as his own.

"Won't all of them make fun of him and mock him with sayings like this? 'How terrible it will be for the one who piles up what is not his own and makes himself rich by taking from others! How long can this go on?'
Won't the people you owe suddenly rise up? Won't they wake up and make you tremble? Then you will become their victim.
Because you have robbed many nations, the people who are left will rob you. You have shed people's blood and done violence to lands, cities, and everyone who lives in them.
"How terrible it will be for the one who builds his house with dishonest gain, setting his nest up high to escape disaster!
You have plotted to wipe out many peoples, but you have brought shame on your own house and lost your own life.
The very stones of the wall will cry out against you, and the beams of the woodwork will answer them.
"How terrible it will be for the one who builds a town with bloodshed and sets up a city with wickedness!
Hasn't the LORD of Armies decided that the people's work will only feed the fire, and that nations wear themselves out for nothing?
For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
"How terrible it will be for the one who gives his neighbors drink, pouring out wine until they are drunk, so that he can look at their naked bodies!
You will be filled with shame instead of glory. Now it is your turn! Drink and be exposed! The cup in the LORD's right hand is coming around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

The violence you did to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and your destruction of its animals will terrify you. You have shed people's blood and done violence to lands, cities, and everyone who lives in them.
"What good is an idol carved by a craftsman? What good is a metal image that teaches lies? The one who makes it trusts in his own creation, but he makes idols that cannot speak.

How terrible it will be for anyone who says to a piece of wood, 'Wake up!' or to a lifeless stone, 'Get up!' Can it teach anything? It may be covered with gold and silver, but there is no breath in it at all.
But the LORD is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him."
